license: LFM Open License v1.0 (upstream checkpoint and ONNX derivative; see LICENSE and LICENSE-NOTICE.md)
format: ONNX image decision stack (MatMulNBits 4-bit; vision fp16, embedding/decision 4-bit quantized)
runtime: ONNX Runtime 1.22 ARM64 (opsets: vision ai.onnx v21 + com.microsoft, decision ai.onnx v18 + com.microsoft)

vision_inputs.pixel_values: float32 [num_crops, max_num_patches=1024, 3*16*16=768], RGB normalized to [-1,1], NaFlex patches
vision_inputs.spatial_shapes: int64 [num_crops, 2] patch grid (ph, pw); a single 512x512 crop is [[32,32]]

contract.vision_output: image_features float32 [num_features, 1024]; 256 prefix embeddings for one 512x512 crop

decision_inputs.inputs_embeds: float32 [1, prefix_len+length, 1024] vision prefix then token embeddings

contract.decision_output: logits float32 [1, options]; softmax over the option markers (no temperature is applied for image answers)

validated_on: ONNX Runtime 1.22.0, macOS x86_64 JVM, three synthetic 512x512 sheets (finite marker logits)
ONNX Runtime 1.22.0 Android, arm64-v8a SDK 35 emulator, live camera preview (one accepted decision, one 30 s timeout fallback)
notes: Decision graph is decision_q4 (4-bit MatMulNBits), not decision_quantized (8-bit): on ORT 1.22 the official 8-bit graph fails at session run with 'nbits_ == 4 was false. Only 4b quantization is supported for unpacked compute.' because its MatMulNBits nodes lack the accuracy_level=4 attribute that selects the prepacked SQ8 kernel; the failure reproduces on macOS x86_64 and Android arm64. The 4-bit graph runs on both. Audio graphs and the merged text model are intentionally excluded.
